newsitem.title: HUNGARY: RABOBANK STARTS TVK COVERAGE WITH 'HOLD'.
newsitem.headline: RABOBANK STARTS TVK COVERAGE WITH 'HOLD'.

text.p: Rabobank Investment Ltd started coverage of Hungarian chemicals firm TVK with a 'hold' recommendation, saying the share was at its fair value.
"We believe that compared to the market and other internationally comparable companies, the company is fairly valued," analyst Anthony Vago said in a report.
He said that Rabobank expected capacity increases in the U.S. "which will lead to a downturn in plastics prices in the second half (of 1997) and through 1998."
He forecast TVK's earnings per share to amount to 465.8 forints in 1997 and 372.8 forints in 1998.
Rabobank Investment Ltd is the securities arm of Rabobank Hungaria, which is a unit of Rabobank Nederland.
